## Research interests

Applied econometrics; monetary economics; central banking; digital currencies; causal policy evaluation; international political economy; governance and institutional capacity; AI-assisted economic intelligence.

## Selected research

**CBDC and Monetary Transmission in Switzerland**  
Graduate research paper. Studies monetary-policy pass-through across lending, deposit, credit, and exchange-rate channels.

**Quantitative Easing and the Balance-Sheet Channel**  
Research project. Examines Federal Reserve holdings and the ten-year Treasury term premium using time-series methods.

**Israel Bilateral Defense Trade**  
Graduate econometrics project. Analyzes bilateral trade, structural change, and supplier concentration in strategically relevant product groups.

**Medicaid Expansion and Health Outcomes**  
Replication and policy-analysis project using difference-in-differences and state-clustered inference.

## Technical skills

**Programming:** R, Python  
**Econometrics:** causal inference, panel-data models, time-series analysis, robust inference  
**Research tools:** Quarto, LaTeX, Git, GitHub, Jupyter, Overleaf  
**Data:** UN Comtrade, BIS, SNB, Federal Reserve and U.S. Treasury sources
